methodology.Fees: Protocol fee paid by the taker when a leg is funded, on top of the escrowed amount (FeeCollected on EVM and TRON, the fee field of Funded on Solana). It is not refunded.
methodology.Revenue: All protocol fees (Fees paid by the taker when a leg is funded) go to the Hashlock Markets treasury.
methodology.ProtocolRevenue: All protocol fees (Fees paid by the taker when a leg is funded) go to the Hashlock Markets treasury.
methodology.HoldersRevenue: Money going to governance token holders
methodology.Volume: Settled trade volume. Each trade is counted once, at the first claim of its hashlock (the claim that reveals the secret, ordered by block time across chains), at that leg's escrowed amount; refunded legs and unsettled trades are not counted. A trade with a Bitcoin leg is counted through its other leg.

Fees.Token Swap Fees: Protocol fee on each funded leg, paid by the taker.

Revenue.Token Swap Fees To Treasury: Protocol fee on each funded leg, kept by the Hashlock Markets treasury.

ProtocolRevenue.Token Swap Fees To Treasury: Protocol fee on each funded leg, kept by the Hashlock Markets treasury.

methodology.Volume: Total amount wagered across all live Suigar casino games (Coinflip, Limbo, Plinko, Range, Wheel, Soccer, Keno, PvP Coinflip), summed from each settled bet's stake_amount on suigar::core::BetResultEvent.
methodology.Fees: House edge realized on settled bets: stake minus payout, summed across all games.
methodology.UserFees: The net amount players lose to the house on settled bets.
methodology.Revenue: No revenue is generated from the casino, all the casino house edge are paid to the LPs.
methodology.SupplySideRevenue: 100% of fees accrue to SweetHouse LPs who back the bankroll across its private, public, rakeback and whitelist pools.

Fees.Casino house edge: Stake minus payout on every settled bet across all live Suigar games (Coinflip, Limbo, Plinko, Range, Wheel, Soccer, Keno, PvP Coinflip), read from each game's suigar::core::BetResultEvent. Negative on days the house pays out more than it collects.

SupplySideRevenue.Casino house edge: SweetHouse LPs (private, public, rakeback and whitelist pools) are the counterparty to every bet and bear its house edge as pool P&L.
